ceu: ✦ The square between Venus and Saturn

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between your career and your image. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between your horizons and your inner life. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between intimacy and friendships. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between relationships and your career. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between routine and your horizons. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between romance and intimacy. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between family and relationships. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between conversations and routine. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Share a meal with someone important to you.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between money and romance. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Make a short list of three tasks and get them done.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between your image and family. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Go for a walk with no destination and no hurry.

t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Look at an old photograph and remember where your strength comes from.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between friendships and money. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Reply to that message you keep leaving for later.
